title: SMB Server
desc: Share local directories over SMB with Windows, macOS, Linux, phones and TVs
listenIpPlaceholder: Leave empty to listen on all addresses
portHelp: Windows only connects to port 445; if Samba or another service already uses 445 on this host, pick another port, which macOS, Linux and most media players can specify
encryptionHelp: Require SMB 3 encryption on every connection; older devices and some TVs that only speak SMB 2 will not be able to connect
mdnsHelp: Show this service under Network in the macOS Finder
usersDesc: Each directory is a share; a single directory is shared under the user's name
connectDesc: Built from the saved settings, using the host you are visiting
windowsPortOnly: Not port 445, Windows cannot connect directly
unsupported: The SMB service is not available on this system; only Linux and macOS are supported
